correctness.rationale: On A²(B_2), normalized monomials have squared norms 2u!v!/(u+v+2)!, so the companion maps each monomial to the unique orthogonal shifted monomial with singular weight exp(-epsilon u-epsilon^a v)*m/(m+k)*sqrt(prod(v+j)/(m+2+j)). Independently verified factorial-weight identities for k=1..4, u,v<=6. For v large, ratio to (v/(u+v))^(kp/2) has uniform O(1/v) relative error; finitely many v cost lower order. Inner positive decreasing sum differs from v*H_q(p epsilon v) by at most 1. Uniform Laplace asymptotics and v-scale epsilon^(-a) Riemann sums yield gamma/p², (1-a)log/p², 1/[p²(q-1)] coefficients in q<1,=1,>1. Compactness for epsilon>0 follows exponential damping. Domain fixed a in (0,1), p>0.
